title: Keto Basque-Style Cheesecake
description: A rich, creamy, and decadent dessert inspired by the flavors of the Basque region, made keto-friendly by using a sugar-free sweetener and a blend of full-fat cheeses. A perfect treat for those following a keto diet.
instructions: Make sure all the ingredients are at room temperature before proceeding.
In a blender or food processor, blend the chocolate, Turkish Delight, cream cheese, eggs, sweetener, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Add the softened butter and blend until fully incorporated.
Stir in the sour cream and xanthan gum.
Pour the mixture into a greased 23cm (9-inch) cheesecake pan.
Bake for 40-45 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool in the pan for 10 minutes.
Run a knife around the edges to release the cheesecake.
Let cool completely on a wire rack.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours before serving.
